observation.visible_scene: A shirtless boy in dark floral swim trunks stands barefoot on a rectangular black mat laid on a wooden dock projecting over a calm lake, with a tree-lined far shore and bright sky behind him. Throughout the excerpt he stays planted on the mat and moves only his arms.
visible_changes: At the start (t=0) his elbows are bent with hands held in front of his chest; over the next few frames the hands drop toward his hips and clench.
The arms then sweep outward and downward until they are extended roughly to the sides at shoulder height (around t=0.4–0.5).
Elbows bend again and the hands rise from the sides up to shoulder/head level and then extend overhead (first peak around t=0.8–1.0, a fuller overhead raise around t=1.9–2.0).
The arms lower back down, passing in front of the torso (visible motion blur around t=2.1–2.3), returning to the sides and hips.
This outward-then-up swinging sequence repeats: arms sweep out to horizontal again around t=2.6–2.7 and rise overhead once more by t=3.1–3.2.
The legs, feet, and overall standing posture remain essentially fixed; only the arms change position, with a slight torso sway accompanying the swings.
The background and dock planks keep a consistent position across frames, indicating a stationary camera rather than object or camera translation.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the boy began or will continue this arm-swinging pattern beyond the cropped segment, and how many repetitions the full activity contains.
Any instruction, music, or purpose prompting the motion.
uncertain_details: The precise count of complete arm cycles within the excerpt.
Whether there is any very slight change in framing/subject size late in the clip versus a true camera move.
The degree of intentional body sway versus incidental movement during the arm swings.
